title: Traditional Slovakian Popcorn Pudding
description: A unique dessert inspired by Slovakian cuisine, blending the comfort of roasted flavor with the excitement of popcorn.
instructions: In a large saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the granulated sugar and cook, stirring occasionally, until the mixture turns golden brown.
In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs and vanilla extract together.
Add the flour to the egg mixture and whisk until smooth.
Add the cooked sugar mixture to the egg mixture, then stir in the popped popcorn and roasted hazelnuts.
Pour the mixture into a greased 6-cup pudding mold.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean.
Let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
